name: iblusend
description: Safely triage conversations, manage contacts, and send confirmed iMessages and SMS through one consented workspace.

interface.shortDescription: Safely triage conversations, manage contacts, and send confirmed iMessages and SMS through one consented workspace.
interface.longDescription: Connect one iBluSend workspace to inspect conversations, contacts, devices, groups, delivery status, opt-out state, and bot status. Draft and send only after showing the exact destination and content for approval.
defaultPrompt: Triage my iBluSend inbox and flag conversations that need a reply.
Draft a reply for one contact, then wait for my approval before sending.
Check this contact's opt-out status and show available sending devices.
